name: default-url-smoke
description: T-120 PLAY gate: the DEFAULT URL (index.html, the six-face run a player opens; the harness adds only testapi=1 and, with --deterministic, fixeddt) played for 4 s of game time: hold right and fire, hop on a fixed rhythm, tilt the gun up once. A smoke, not a policy: it proves the shipped run boots and plays a frame-exact schedule with no page error and no stall (tools/orch/smoke-verdict.mjs). The two older smoke scripts boot opt-in fixtures (?slice=traversal, ?slice=transform&enemies=0); this one is the page a player gets.
